body:
Hey again @everyone. Time for a new build contest and a few quick general updates.

🏭Build Contest: Factory

From deeply industrial to steampunk to magic and more!

  • 🗓️Due Date: Friday, December 12, 2025 11:59 PM PST. This is ~4 days longer than normal to account for Thanksgiving for those celebrating.

    • This event is also listed on the calendar.

  • ✏️Prize Info: Can be found here.

  • 🏆Special Prize: Entrants for the top 3 submissions earn +1 Charms slot and 5 Wind-up Keys from the Valor Gift Shop.

📝General Updates

  • 🐺Cerberus now displays its loading phase progress on the action bar while it's held in either form.

  • 🤖Copper Golems are now automatically protected by whoever spawned them. This works retroactively.

  • 💛Curse of Bloodletting now consumes Absorption hearts first if you have any.

  • 🎄Early FYI that we'll run our typical 12 Days of Christmas gift event next month. Fireplace registration will open closer to the event, though of course feel free to prep them now if you'd like!

🫶 Happy to see a decent number of you still hopping on this deep into the map. Much love!
